chunks: A group of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) never spoke to the servants with the full depth of his intellect at all. And he said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Indeed we, the community of Prophets, have been commanded to speak to people according to the level of their intellects.

key_terms.عَقْل: Intellect, reason — the faculty that distinguishes humans and determines their capacity to receive divine guidance
key_terms.قَدْر: Measure, level, capacity — the intellectual and spiritual capacity of each individual
key_terms.كُنْه: Depth, full reality, essence — indicating the Prophet's intellect was so vast it was never fully revealed

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet Muhammad speak to people according to their level of understanding?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates two related teachings: first, that the Prophet Muhammad never disclosed the full depth of his intellectual capacity to people; and second, a prophetic saying that all prophets are commanded by God to calibrate their speech to the comprehension level of their audience. This reflects the Islamic pedagogical principle of meeting people where they are intellectually — a tradition dating back to prophetic practice.
